'''October 1999 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Game Wizard, 704 NW 65th St., Seattle, WA on 10 October 1999. [[Douglas Harvilla]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d111">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-17-seattle-wa-10-10-99d111/ seattle-wa-10-10-99], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 17 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-17-seattle-wa-10-10-99d111/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 October 1999
* '''Site:''' Game Wizard, 704 NW 65th St., Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
